log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Their team is heavily Dragon-based, so Sylveon is essential. Gholdengo blocks status and pressures Milotic/Gliscor, and Kingambit gives priority and Steel coverage. Garchomp mirrors badly and Dragonite is redundant with Sylveon around.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Opponent is dragon-heavy. Bring Sylveon, Gholdengo, Kingambit? Sylveon handles dragons, Gholdengo blocks status. Lead Sylveon.

decisions.thought:
Lead: 39% BRING: garchomp, 34% BRING: dragapult, 11% BRING: hydreigon
Pick 2: 34% BRING: dragapult, 25% BRING: kommoo, 23% BRING: hydreigon
Pick 3: 38% BRING: kommoo, 29% BRING: hydreigon, 20% BRING: gliscor
40% MOVE: earthquake, 25% MOVE: stealthrock, 16% MOVE: stoneedge
Garchomp outspeeds and likely runs Swords Dance or Scale Shot; Sylveon can't safely attack first. Yawn forces it out or threatens sleep, blunting any setup attempt while Sylveon stays healthy.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp likely SD/Scale Shot; Sylveon slower. Hyper Voice hits decently but Garchomp may set up. Yawn forces switch or sleep—good vs setup. I'll Yawn.

decisions.thought: 26% SWITCH: dragapult, 26% MOVE: earthquake, 20% MOVE: stoneedge

Garchomp is faster and will likely KO my 22% Sylveon with Earthquake. Protect is safe: it blocks the EQ, and the Yawn already on Garchomp puts it to sleep next turn, giving me a free switch or Wish afterward.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp will KO Sylveon with EQ likely; Sylveon slow. Protect to scout? Yawn already on Garchomp—sleeps next turn. Protect lets Yawn land, Sylveon survives? EQ at 22% likely KO. Protect is safe: Yawn triggers, Garchomp sleeps.

decisions.thought: 48% MOVE: shadowball, 12% MOVE: uturn, 12% MOVE: dragontail

Sylveon is at 28% and Dragapult is much faster, so staying likely means losing it. Gholdengo resists nothing here but is immune to Dragon moves via Ghost typing and Good as Gold blocks status. Switching preserves Sylveon for later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sylveon nearly dead, Dragapult faster and likely outspeeds; switch to Gholdengo immune to most, blocks status.

decisions.thought: 78% MOVE: shadowball, 13% SWITCH: kommoo, 10% SWITCH: garchomp

Dragapult may outspeed and its Shadow Ball is super effective on my weakened Gholdengo, but Make It Rain with Life Orb off 185 SpA very likely OHKOs the frail Dragapult first. Attacking is the best play; switching wastes Gholdengo's offensive momentum.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Gholdengo at 39.5%, Dragapult faster possibly, Shadow Ball 2x could KO. Make It Rain likely KOs Dragapult (185 SpA, 120 BP, Life Orb). Dragapult may outspeed and KO with Shadow Ball. Risky but Make It Rain is best play—likely OHKO.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo fainted, so I must switch. Sylveon is at 28% and Dragapult outspeeds and OHKOs it with Shadow Ball. Kingambit resists Shadow Ball (Dark) and threatens Dragapult with Sucker Punch, making it the safe switch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sylveon is nearly dead, Garchomp has Yawn (will fall asleep next switch-in? Yawn on Garchomp still pending—actually Yawn was applied turn 1, Garchomp switched out, yawn cleared). Dragapult threatens; Kingambit resists Shadow Ball? Ghost vs Dark/Steel: Ghost weak vs Dark... Shadow Ball is super effective on Ghost? Dark resists Ghost, Steel neutral → resisted. Kingambit good switch.

decisions.thought: 49% SWITCH: kommoo, 35% SWITCH: garchomp, 16% MOVE: shadowball

Dragapult is much faster and just KO'd Gholdengo, so it will almost certainly attack. Sucker Punch gets priority, is super effective, and boosted by Supreme Overlord, likely scoring a knockout before Dragapult moves.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sucker Punch: Dragapult likely attacks; +1 priority, super effective, Supreme Overlord boost. Kowtow also SE but Dragapult faster. Sucker Punch safest KO.

decisions.thought: 62% MOVE: focusblast, 21% MOVE: earthquake, 7% SWITCH: dragapult

Kommo-o resists Dark, so Kowtow Cleave and Sucker Punch are weak options. Iron Head hits neutrally with a flinch chance, and Kingambit's Supreme Overlord boost makes it meaningful. Sylveon is at 28% and risks taking a hit.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Kommo-o resists Dark, weak to Fairy. Kingambit vs Kommo-o: Iron Head neutral, Kowtow resisted. Sylveon weak to Kommo-o? Kommo-o has no revealed moves. Sylveon at 28% risky. Iron Head is safest; Kommo-o may Clangorous Soul etc. Iron Head.

decisions.thought: Only legal action is sending in Sylveon, which resists Focus Blast and threatens Kommo-o with Hyper Voice.
30% MOVE: earthquake, 25% SWITCH: dragapult, 18% SWITCH: garchomp
Kommo-o is faster and Focus Blast will KO my 28% Sylveon this turn. Protect is the only way to survive, letting Leftovers tick and setting up Wish next turn.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sylveon at 28%, Kommo-o faster with Focus Blast likely KO. Protect to scout/safe? Focus Blast likely KOs even through protect? No, protect blocks. But then next turn still dead. Yawn? Sylveon likely dies to Focus Blast. Protect stalls a turn, leftovers, then Wish next turn? Protect then Wish is too slow. Best: Protect to guarantee survival this turn, then Wish. Actually Focus Blast may not KO (28% HP, 202 max, ~57 HP; Focus Blast ~90-100+ damage, definitely KO). Protect is only option to survive.

decisions.thought: 42% MOVE: earthquake, 24% SWITCH: dragapult, 15% SWITCH: garchomp
Sylveon is at 34% and slower than Kommo-o, which likely has a strong Dragon STAB coming. Wish now sets up recovery so Sylveon can keep checking Kommo-o; Protect next turn combos with it.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Kommo-o likely Clangorous Soulblitz/scale shot next; Sylveon low HP. Wish then protect next turn? Wish now is standard.
